# Fixture provenance

All fixtures in this directory are verification artifacts written by the `verifier`
teammate. None of them are produced by the implementation under test (`./ccfddl`).

## 1. `allconf_live.json` — live CCFDDL catalog snapshot

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| URL | `https://ccfddl.com/conference/allconf.json` |
| Fetched (UTC) | 2026-10-18T07:55:34Z |
| Fetched (Asia/Shanghai) | 2026-10-18T15:55:34+08:00 |
| HTTP status | 200 |
| Content-Type | `application/json; charset=utf-8` |
| Bytes | 777 074 |
| SHA-256 | `19ad4305b5d80c5ea599d320bee33bd09b537c1000f5c8fd4d522c359ca88879` |
| `last-modified` (server) | Sat, 17 Oct 2026 03:43:17 GMT |
| Response `date` (server) | Sun, 18 Oct 2026 07:55:34 GMT |
| Structure | JSON list, 378 conference series, 2315 editions, 2892 timeline entries |

Fetch command used:

```sh
curl -sS -L --max-time 60 -A "ccfddl-verifier/1.0 (independent verification)" \
  -o tests/fixtures/allconf_live.json \
  -w "http_code=%{http_code} size=%{size_download} time=%{time_total}\n" \
  https://ccfddl.com/conference/allconf.json
# => http_code=200 size=777074 time=1.398837
```

The catalog is re-fetched freshly during verification (Turn 2); this snapshot only
pins the data used to build `expected_live.json` and the offline tests. Because the
upstream file is updated several times a week, counts/rows in `expected_live.json`
are a point-in-time oracle, not constants; the verification harness regenerates them
with `tests/oracle_live.py` from a fresh download.

## 2. `expected_live.json` — independent oracle output for the snapshot above

Generated by `tests/oracle_live.py` (verifier code, stdlib only, does not import
`./ccfddl` or any source-scout code):

```sh
python3 tests/oracle_live.py \
  --catalog tests/fixtures/allconf_live.json \
  --now 2026-10-18T07:55:34Z \
  --out tests/fixtures/expected_live.json
# wrote tests/fixtures/expected_live.json: 20 events, 3 tbd, tracked_series=61
```

Reference instant `2026-10-18T07:55:34+00:00` (the fetch instant), display timezone
`Asia/Shanghai`, category `AI`, paper (`deadline`) events only, no `--days`/`--limit`.
Contains the complete event list with audit fields (`deadline_source`,
`source_timezone`, abstract info, ranks, date/place/link), a compact `event_set`
tuple list `[conference_key, year, deadline_utc, comment, kind]`, and the SPEC §4.4
TBD list.

## 3. `synthetic_tz.json` — deterministic timezone matrix (11 series)

Hand-built by the verifier to pin SPEC §3.3 timezone semantics. Every deadline is in
2033 (far in the future, so "upcoming" selection stays valid) and every series is in
area `AI`, with fake venues (`TZ …`, `example.invalid` links) so no live-data
knowledge is required. It deliberately includes:

| conference_key | source tz | raw deadline | expected UTC | expected Asia/Shanghai |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AI/tz-aoe` | `AoE` | `2033-01-10 23:59:59` | `2033-01-11T11:59:59Z` | `2033-01-11T19:59:59+08:00` |
| `AI/tz-utcm12` | `UTC-12` | `2033-02-10 23:59:59` | `2033-02-11T11:59:59Z` | `2033-02-11T19:59:59+08:00` |
| `AI/tz-utc` | `UTC` | `2033-03-10 12:00:00` | `2033-03-10T12:00:00Z` | `2033-03-10T20:00:00+08:00` |
| `AI/tz-utc0` | `UTC+0` | `2033-03-10 12:00:00` | `2033-03-10T12:00:00Z` | `2033-03-10T20:00:00+08:00` |
| `AI/tz-utcp10` | `UTC+10` | `2033-03-10 22:00:00` | `2033-03-10T12:00:00Z` | `2033-03-10T20:00:00+08:00` |
| `AI/tz-utcp8` | `UTC+8` | `2033-03-10 20:00:00` | `2033-03-10T12:00:00Z` | `2033-03-10T20:00:00+08:00` |
| `AI/tz-utcm5` | `UTC-5` | `2033-03-10 07:00:00` | `2033-03-10T12:00:00Z` | `2033-03-10T20:00:00+08:00` |
| `AI/tz-pt-winter` | `PT` | `2033-01-15 23:59:59` | `2033-01-16T07:59:59Z` | `2033-01-16T15:59:59+08:00` |
| `AI/tz-pt-summer` | `PT` | `2033-07-15 23:59:59` | `2033-07-16T06:59:59Z` | `2033-07-16T14:59:59+08:00` |
| `AI/tz-pt-spring` | `PT` | `2033-03-14 00:30:00` | `2033-03-14T07:30:00Z` | `2033-03-14T15:30:00+08:00` |
| `AI/tz-pt-fall` | `PT` | `2033-11-07 00:30:00` | `2033-11-07T08:30:00Z` | `2033-11-07T16:30:00+08:00` |

DST calibration (US rules, `America/Los_Angeles`): spring-forward 2033-03-13
(PST −08:00 → PDT −07:00, so 2033-03-14 00:30 PT = 07:30Z), fall-back 2033-11-06
(PDT −07:00 → PST −08:00, so 2033-11-07 00:30 PT = 08:30Z).

**Sign-trap regression case:** `UTC-12` must be offset `−12h`. A wrong `+12h`
mapping turns `2033-02-10 23:59:59` into `2033-02-10T11:59:59Z`, i.e. one day
earlier than the correct `2033-02-11T11:59:59Z`. Tests assert both UTC and
Asia/Shanghai values for this vein.

## 4. `synthetic_edge.json` — selection / schema / rendering edge cases (18 series)

Hand-built by the verifier; all AI deadlines are in 2033 except where a past or
TBD value is the point. Fake venues and `example.invalid` links throughout.

| series | tests |
|---|---|
| `AI/rounds` | two distinct rounds, comments preserved, not merged |
| `AI/absduo` | abstract + paper both dated, abstract rendered |
| `AI/allkinds` | paper/abstract/rebuttal/decision nodes for `--all-kinds`/`--details` |
| `AI/tbded` | latest-edition `deadline: "TBD"` → TBD section only |
| `AI/tbdabs` | abstract `TBD`, paper dated → paper event, `abstract_*` null |
| `AI/abstbd2` | paper `TBD`, abstract dated → TBD section, never a paper row |
| `AI/passed` | latest edition deadline already passed → **not** TBD (SPEC §4.4 note) |
| `AI/oldtbd` | latest edition year < current display year → not TBD |
| `AI/same-name-ai`, `CG/same-name-cg` | duplicate title across areas; identity is `conference_key` |
| `AI/missingranks` | `rank` lacks `core`/`thcpl` (ccf only) |
| `AI/norank` | empty `rank` object → rank must not be invented |
| `AI/unknown-tz` | source timezone `MARS` → skipped/reported, never treated as local |
| `AI/dupe` | exact duplicate timeline entry → deduplicated to one event |
| `AI/detailv` | `--details` full timeline incl. PASSED nodes; also not TBD (announced deadlines) |
| `AI/multi` | historical 2025 edition ignored; 2033 edition selected |
| `AI/freetext` | `date`/`place` = `"TBD"`, no `link` field |
| `AI/longnote` | very long `comment` → Note column truncation at narrow widths |

Oracle output for this fixture at reference `2026-10-18T07:55:34Z`, `AI`: 12 upcoming
paper events, 2 TBD series (`ABSTBD2`, `TBDED`), 17 tracked AI series, 1 skipped
unknown-timezone edition.

No fixture contains data copied from `./ccfddl`, `research/`, or `legacy/`.
